name: Pending Opening Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for a pending account opening status.

ATHP.name: Authorised But Pending
ATHP.definition: Authorisation is provided but account opening is still pending.

KYCM.name: Know Your Customer Document Missing
KYCM.definition: Know Your Customer (KYC) document is missing.

NOTO.name: Not Opened
NOTO.definition: Account is not yet open, even for partial use.

REST.name: Restrictions
REST.definition: Account will be opened when restrictions are addressed.
